name: VidCrawl
tagline: Extract video transcripts, storyboard frames, and structured insights for AI agents
description: Remote and local MCP server for extracting clean timestamped Markdown transcripts, visual storyboard contact sheets, targeted HD frames, and structured agent insights from YouTube, TikTok, Instagram, and X videos.

env.name: VIDCRAWL_API_KEY
env.description: VidCrawl API key (100 free credits on signup, no card required). Or connect directly via hosted HTTP at https://vidcrawl.com/mcp.

install.notes: Hosted Streamable HTTP is also available at https://vidcrawl.com/mcp with header `Authorization: Bearer $VIDCRAWL_API_KEY`.
